channel.title: Pulumi incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Pulumi's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Some Team Access Token operations failing [resolved]
Degraded performance for Pulumi Cloud login [resolved]
Bitbucket authentication failures affecting sign-in and Bitbucket-backed accounts [resolved]
item.description: The incident has now been resolved and the service is operating normally for all customers.

item.title: Elevated API error rates and latency [resolved]
Elevated errors when decrypting ESC environments [resolved]
item.description:
Some Pulumi Cloud organizations experienced elevated errors when decrypting ESC environments. A subset of environment revisions were affected, and those revisions failed to decrypt 100% of the time during the window. Overall, 3.32% of decrypt-attempt requests across Pulumi Cloud failed due to this issue.
At the start of the window, we rolled out a change that prevented secret ciphertext copied from an ESC environment from being decrypted in other environments. Customers who had previously copied ciphertext between environments were affected. Users saw a message: “decryption failed. If this secret's ciphertext was copied from a different environment, copy and paste the plaintext instead.” This change was intended as a security improvement, but the customer impact was higher than expected,

item.title: Machine tokens unable to open referenced environments when running stack previews. [resolved]
Errors when creating new Pulumi Neo tasks [resolved]
item.description: We've identified and rolled back the change that caused the issue. The incident is now resolved.

item.title: get.pulumi.com unreachable [resolved]
item.description: Cloudflare has restored the impacted services.

item.title: Issue displaying some previews in Pulumi Cloud [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting previews in Pulumi Cloud has been resolved. Previews are functioning normally again. Please note that affected previews during the incident window (between 11pm UTC Sept 7, 2025 and 7pm UTC Sept 8, 2025) were not recoverable and will not be available in your history.
